deadline.value: No deadline for international applicants is stated. The 2027 international scholarship round closed on 15 September 2026; applications can be submitted at any time.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Applicants must contact a potential supervisor before applying, because supervisors must support the application before it can be processed.
supervisor.quote: This is essential as supervisors need to provide support to your application before it can be processed.

funding.value: ICRAR/UWA scholarships are described as extremely competitive.

entry_route.value: UWA requires adequate research preparation; the fetched pages do not say whether a bachelor's degree alone is enough.

notes: ICRAR/UWA runs its own PhD call. The 2027 domestic round opened 1 October 2026 and closes 31 October 2026, for domestic students only. The page says international scholarships are next expected to open in August 2027. Applicants must identify a project and contact the project lead before applying.
